title: dryopteris simonsii
intro: Dryopteris simonsii, commonly known as Himalayan shield fern, is a species of fern native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris simonsii include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
